concept.title: Release notes:
concept.shortdesc: The first release: migration with proof, the fix agent, the cloud runtime, the console and this help.

ul.li: Five deterministic tools: inventory, convert, restore, check and links.
A fix agent on that proposes mapping rules, with attempts per topic.
A Cloud Run job and API that scale to zero, deployed without keys.
A console with context-sensitive help on every screen.
A GitHub Action that checks DITA on every pull request.
This help, written in DITA and migrated to MyST by itself.
